status: Prospective rule for remaining development and final recipe freeze; substantial development results already observed and explicitly exploratory. No selection_dev/selection_holdout outcomes observed.
development_metric: Generated accuracy on fixed513-example accuracy_dev; full inputs; no output-protocol changes

independent_oracle_reference.population: candidate_0 size1024, development starts301/311/321 paired with401/411/421
independent_oracle_reference.selection: Highest mean development accuracy over all3 starts; ties prefer lower mean preparation+online seconds, then fewer steps, then lower learning rate

short_oracle_control.selection: Highest mean candidate_0 development accuracy over3 starts among short Oracle32 configurations; same tie rule. Include even if it is also the chosen full reference.

new_method_screening.screening: Use only development results. Prefer accuracy/time Pareto candidates; a candidate must be tested on candidate_0 and starts301/311/321 before a positive generalization claim. Full4097 pool results alone are insufficient for final candidate-size recipe choice.
new_method_screening.confirmation: Fixed shortlist selected from initial development; then confirm on the two additional development starts and candidate_0. Report all shortlisted failures.
new_method_screening.final_choice: Prefer highest mean accuracy among new methods no slower than originalCV16, then fastest configuration within1percentage point of best available development Oracle; if none meet both, retain at most one informative failure for surrogate fidelity rather than claim success.
new_method_screening.stopping: No new method families beyond currently implemented queues without a concrete diagnostic reason; target method freeze around6hours fromstudy start.

behavior_readout: Select at most one explicit-state behavior model by predictor_dev teacher logit+state-change error. Retain the no-explicit-delta ablation if used in finalstudy. It reconstructs base H from BF16 stored H, so small rounding-dependent state information may remain; do not call it a mathematically state-invariant control. A separate constant-choice baseline is truly independent of candidate outcomes. Forced-format teacher is mandatory; free-generation outcome is separate.
final_outcomes: Do not select a new recipe, stopping point or success threshold from selection_dev/holdout. selection_dev chooses only candidate dataset under each frozen recipe.
scope_note: Development LR/horizon selection is exploratory and uses a repeatedly examined small set; final independent source-group readouts and new starts provide the confirmation, with three-start uncertainty limitations.

clarifications.reason: Precisely describe the no-explicit-delta ablation; no method implementation or selection metric changed.
